short: Every cookie the HTTP driver sets
is: The leaf crate naming every cookie the HTTP driver sets (ZurfurCookie: Session, SignInBinding), the one builder that sets their attributes, and the session layer that issues the session cookie; api and test-support both consume it.
conventions: No cookie name or attribute is spelled outside this crate; drivers and the test rig take them from ZurfurCookie or session_layer.
Wire output is pinned byte for byte by zurfur_cookie/tests.rs: every Set-Cookie, set and clear, secure and not, and the live session layer's.
Lives outside composition so composition stays HTTP-free; never depends on another workspace crate.
A request carrying two or more session cookie pairs is signed out before the session layer reads it; the planted cookie is never cleared.

fs.name: Cargo.toml
fs.role: crate manifest — http + tower-sessions + tower-layer/tower-service + strum; no intra-workspace deps

fs.name: src/lib.rs
fs.role: façade: re-exports ZurfurCookie, set_cookie_header, session_layer and its SessionLayer type, and the SingleSessionCookie guard

fs.name: src/single_session_cookie.rs
fs.role: SingleSessionCookieLayer: ahead of the session layer, drops every zurfur.sid pair (named as the cookie jar decodes it) from a request carrying two or more across all Cookie headers, keeping the other cookies

fs.name: src/single_session_cookie/tests.rs
fs.role: pins the guard on header maps, and served: bare tower-sessions reads the last of two pairs, session_layer reads none

fs.name: src/zurfur_cookie.rs
fs.role: ZurfurCookie: name(secure), cookie() builder, cleared(), infallible cleared_header(); set_cookie_header; session_layer with the 7-day inactivity expiry, behind the single-session-cookie guard

fs.name: src/zurfur_cookie/tests.rs
fs.role: pins every Set-Cookie byte for byte, including the served session layer's
